mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the digestive tract was most worthwhile: the separate food and blood arrows made it clear that absorbed material crosses the gut lining.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the eye and ears was clear but fairly predictable; their locations and nerve routes were already shown.

surprise.text: The repaired skin kept its small scar and connected to neighboring vessels and nerves, rather than representing the whole covering.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; each matched a visible location or connection.

continue.text: I would probably continue if another chapter showed how the assembled parts work together. This chapter brought them together clearly, though the fittings themselves were straightforward.
